articles.title: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane put on IR before surgery to repair torn ACL
articles.summary: The Miami Dolphins, an American football team, received disappointing news following their loss to the Kansas City Chiefs. Medical tests confirmed an injury to their team MVP, De'Von Achane. This development, occurring in Miami Gardens, dampens hopes for the team's future performance, as the much-anticipated positive update did not materialize after the crucial game.

articles.title: Oktane 2026: The industry is ready to talk about AI kill switches | Computer Weekly
articles.summary: Advanced AI models are intensifying data breaches and cyber incidents globally. Identity specialist Okta, at its Oktane 2026 conference, unveiled new solutions to address these evolving cybersecurity threats. This highlights the critical need for robust identity management and secure digital infrastructure against sophisticated AI-powered attacks.
